children.value: cittanāśe na saṃsāraḥ kumbhanāśe na kumbhakham
sā satyatā sā śivatā sāvasthā pāramātmikī
* *? tā sā sā dṛṣṭirnatu yatra manaḥ kṣatam
mano yatra tu tatrāśāstatra duḥkhasukhāni ca
tasmāttvaṃ sadā tadekapravaṇo bhava tallābhāyetyāha - pralapannityādinā
na kevalaṃ nopakartuṃ śaknuvanti kiṃtu tatpurato'vastutāmeva gacchantītyāha tejoṃśuṣu prabhāveṣu baliṣvapi mahatsvapi
idaṃ mameti bhāvena ceto gacchati pīnatām

nītvā śamaṃ rāma manomahāhiṃ
bhayaṃ bhṛśaṃ projjhya bhavābhayātmā

uḍḍīya vai gacchati cittagṛdhro
dehadrumāttannipuṇaṃ jayaste
idānīṃ tadeva cittaṃ meghatvena rūpayati - abhyutthitamiti dvābhyām
satphalasya paramārthasukhasya pakvasasyaphalasya ca kṣayāya akāle samupasthitam

mukhe mukhasadṛśabahirmukhavṛttyagre āsaṅgī pratibimbanena
viṣaktastaḍitsaḍrśaścidābhāsaprakāśo yasya
vāsanāni vāsanāstallakṣaṇayā vātyayā antaḥ āndolitaṃ parivartitam

chittvā svayaṃ rāghava cittapāśaṃ
yathāsukhaṃ tvaṃ viharāstaśaṅkaḥ

akāmanānāmamahānalena
balena dagdhvā vibhavo bhava tvam

cittena cetaḥ śamamāśu nītvā
śuddhena ghorāstramivāstrayuktyā

cirāya sādho tyaja cañcalatvaṃ
vimarkaṭo vṛkṣa ivākṣataśrīḥ

amalamiti ca kṛtvā cetasā vītaśaṅka-
mupaśamitamano'ntaḥ sarvamādehameva

tṛṇalavalaghu paśyaṁllīlayā heyadṛṣṭyā
piba vihara ramasva prāptasaṃsārapāraḥ
